title: Language of binary addition
statement: A Boolean word belongs to this language exactly when it is the concatenation of three Boolean lists $a,b,c$ of equal length and the value represented by $c$ is the sum of the values represented by $a$ and $b$.
hypotheses_covered: The word is a concatenation $a\mathbin{++}b\mathbin{++}c$ of three Boolean lists
The three lists have equal length
The represented value of $c$ equals the sum of the represented values of $a$ and $b$
